judged_assistant_text.text: Compound interest is interest earned on both the original principal and on interest accumulated from prior periods, causing growth to accelerate over time. Unlike simple interest, it compounds because returns are reinvested. Argus can test historical performance of buy-and-hold or DCA strategies, which demonstrate the effect of compounding through price appreciation and reinvested gains.

La inflación es el aumento generalizado y sostenido de los precios de bienes y servicios en una economía, lo que reduce el poder adquisitivo del dinero con el tiempo. En inversiones, afecta el rendimiento real de los activos porque el dinero futuro vale menos que el actual. Puedes probar estrategias históricas como comprar y mantener para ver cómo se comportan en periodos con diferentes niveles de inflación.

Un ETF, o fondo cotizado en bolsa, es un vehículo de inversión que replica el rendimiento de un índice, sector o activo específico y se negocia en el mercado como una acción. Ofrece diversificación con costos bajos y liquidez diaria.

**The latest available U.S. CPI inflation rate is 3.4% year over year, as of July 2026.** August data had not yet been released as of September 9; publication was scheduled for September 11.

| Measure | Latest reading | Recent direction |
|---|---:|---|
| Headline CPI, year over year | 3.4% | Eased from 3.5% in June |
| Headline CPI, month over month | 0.1% | Rebounded after falling 0.4% in June |
| Core CPI, year over year | 2.5% | Eased from 2.6% in June |
| Core CPI, month over month | 0.2% | Up from no change in June |

**What is driving the picture?** Energy prices were 14.7% higher than a year earlier, while food prices rose 3.0% and shelter rose 3.2%. In July alone, energy prices fell 1.5%, helping keep the overall monthly increase modest.

In plain English: inflation cooled slightly on a yearly basis and underlying inflation also eased, but prices were still rising overall. CPI measures changes in consumer prices, not whether prices have returned to earlier levels.
